core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghazanfari is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Lion”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghazanfari corresponds to the Arabic form غضنفری (Arabic nisba of غضنفر (Ghaḍanfar)). Its core sense is of ghazanfar (the lion). Ghazanfari is the nisba (relational) form of غضنفر (Ghaḍanfar) 'lion' — 'leonine, of the lion'. The source gloss 'military commander, warrior' is an extension of the lion-epithet rather than a lexical meaning.
